scripts.db:start: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$databaseConfig = Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^DATABASE_URL=' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $serviceConfig = Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^POSTGRES_SERVICE_NAME=' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; $serviceName = if ($serviceConfig) { $serviceConfig.Line.Split('=', 2)[1].Trim() } else { 'postgresql-x64-18' }; $skipStart = Select-String -Path .env -Pattern '^START_POSTGRES_SERVICE=false$' -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($databaseConfig -and $databaseConfig.Line.ToLower().Contains('postgres')) { if ($skipStart) { Write-Output 'PostgreSQL service startup is disabled.'; exit 0 }; $service = Get-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction Stop; if ($service.Status -ne 'Running') { Start-Service -Name $serviceName }; Write-Output ('PostgreSQL service ' + $serviceName + ' is running.') } else { Write-Output 'SQLite requires no separate service.' }"
scripts.backend: npm run db:start && .\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --app-dir backend --env-file .env
scripts.format: prettier --write src public index.html vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src public index.html vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json README.md .prettierrc.json
